P.name: Spiked Shell
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rammus''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to the sum of {{as|15% '''total''' armor}} and {{as|15% '''total''' magic resistance}}.

Q.name: Powerball
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' rolls into an accelerating ball, {{tip|channel|channeling}} for up to 6 seconds to gain {{sti|ms|{{pp|key=%|150/6 + (235/6-150/6)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=ms}} {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}}}} per second over the duration, up to a maximum of {{pp|key=%|150 + (235-150)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=ms}}.

''Powerball'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or upon casting ''{{ai|Defensive Ball Curl|Rammus}}''.
Q.description2: '''Rammus''' stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} 125 units, though not through terrain. Enemies hit are then {{tip|stun|stunned}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.4}}|Estimated}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 1 second.

W.name: Defensive Ball Curl
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}. While active, enemies that use a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} against '''Rammus''' are dealt {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' magic resistance)}} {{as|magic damage}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Armor|{{ap|27 to 47}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 60}}% '''total''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 60}}% '''total''' magic resistance)}}}}
W.description2: ''Defensive Ball Curl'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically upon casting ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' or ''{{ai|Soaring Slam|Rammus}}''.

E.name: Frenzying Taunt
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' {{tip|taunt|taunts}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}} for a duration. Monsters are additionally dealt {{as|magic damage}} upon being affected.
E.leveling:
{{st|Taunt Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 2}} seconds}}
{{st|Monster Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

R.name: Soaring Slam
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|Cc-immunity|immunity to crowd control}}. Upon arrival, he creates an impact that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description2: If ''Soaring Slam'' was cast during ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'', enemies within the epicenter of the impact are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and are dealt ''{{ais|Powerball|Rammus}}'' damage. ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' will not collide with enemies during the dash, and its channel will be maintained for the dash and end afterwards.
R.description3: The impact causes 3 aftershocks to burst from the area over {{fd|3.5}} seconds, each one applying and refreshing the duration of the initial {{tip|slow}}.
R.description4: ''Soaring Slam's'' damage affects {{tip|structures}} and is doubled against {{tip|turrets}}.
